lee: Heads-up from CS: two customers reported quota spikes after we moved an SA between orgs yesterday. Billing shows traffic still charged to old org.

nina: Can you paste an example log line?

lee: Example from edge logs: ```json
{"ts":"2026-03-22T09:03:12Z","token":"tok-xxx","resolved_org":"org-old","db_org":"org-new","sa":"sa-998"}
```

omar: Those fields imply the edge auth cache resolved to the old mapping. We TTL tokens for 24h in the router cache, so transfer won't be visible until expiry.

tess: UX question: customers expect transfer to move billing immediately. We need to be explicit in the console about post-transfer behavior. Two options: (A) immediate rebind (rotate tokens), (B) preserve billing until tokens expire. Which is default?

nina: Legal/CS will want an option to preserve prior billing for a short grace for disputes. We should add a checkbox on transfer modal: "Preserve billing for active tokens (30m)" and default to NOT preserving.

omar: Implementation idea that won't force rotations: add an SA "transfer_epoch" integer that increments on transfer. When issuing tokens, embed epoch in token metadata (signed). Auth-router checks token epoch vs SA epoch; if token_epoch < current_epoch -> consider mapping stale and consult authoritative store (bypass cache) to get current org and, if discrepancy, emit metric `billing.transfer_mismatch`. The router can continue to serve but use DB org for billing attribution.

lee: That solves correctness but may increase latency on first post-transfer request while router refreshes. We can mitigate with async invalidation: on transfer, publish a message to auth-router invalidation channel so edge nodes evict cache immediately.

tess: Good. Also add console copy: "Rebind active tokens now" button that triggers: increment epoch + optional revoke call + notification to integrations. Default behavior: prompt with tradeoffs.

omar: Telemetry: emit `auth.invalidate_push_success` and `auth.invalidate_push_fail` per node, `auth.cache_eviction_count`, `billing.transfer_mismatch_count`. Alert if mismatch_count > 5/min for any org.

nina: Canary plan: roll the invalidation listener + epoch-check to canary 3% w/ detailed logs turned on for the auth-router. Monitor `p50_auth_latency` and the new metrics for 6 hours before widening.

lee: Also capture traces with tag `auth.transfer_epoch` and include `db_org` vs `resolved_org` in the span attrs so we can surface examples in the dashboard.

tess: CS action: draft customer-facing note explaining transfer options and recommendation to rotate long lived tokens after transfer.

omar: Action items:
- omar: PR for epoch token encoding + router check + invalidation listener (ETA 2d)
- nina: Console modal copy + checkbox + "Rebind now" button mockups (ETA 3d)
- tess: CS blurb + escalation playbook (ETA 2d)
- lee: dashboard tile: "SA transfer billing mismatches" metric = `billing.transfer_mismatch_count` + example rows (ETA 1d)

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: auth-router v2.3.1 -> canary 3% (PR #4301)

lee: Thanks — keeping this thread as the coordination hub. We'll follow up in tomorrow standup. :thumbsup:
